# Write a useful note {#sec-writing}

## Pick one question

A short, focused document is easier to review and update. Begin with a question,
describe your inputs, and explain what the reader should learn.

## Keep a consistent structure

| Part | Reader's question |
|:-----|:------------------|
| Context | Why should I care? |
| Method | What did you do? |
| Result | What did you find? |
| Next step | What can I try? |

: A reusable outline for a short note. {#tbl-outline}

@tbl-outline is a starting point. Adapt it to your audience.

::: {.callout-tip}
## One chapter per file

Add each chapter to the `book.chapters` list in `_quarto.yml`. The list determines
the reading order across HTML, PDF, and EPUB.
:::
